_about: The MD-80's nacelle inlet and stub pylon from the front, measured on its own sheet's front view (2.2, the same scan: raw image cropped 700,1960,1960,2380, enlarged 4 times, turned 0.25°; its own scale 130.9 px a meter from the printed 32.85 m span; fuselage centerline 2442, the section's middle height 712) and written here in the MD-90 front raster's pixels (md90/front.anchors.json: centerline 3009, crown top 790 at 1.876 m above the tube's centerline, 176.13 px a meter). The inlet's outer ring: 2.70 m out, 0.15 m above the centerline, 1.65 m wide and 1.71 m tall. The pylon: 1.71 to 1.87 m out, from 0.46 m above the centerline to 0.05 m below.
